source_quote: Short-lifespan cohorts showed elevated DCM burden.
Short-lifespan heavy breeds had earlier osteoarthritis prevalence.
Medium-lifespan breeds demonstrated moderate hip dysplasia prevalence.
Atopic dermatitis prevalence remained stable in medium-lifespan breeds.
Long-lifespan toy and companion groups accumulated periodontal disease burden.
Long-lived small breeds showed elevated luxating patella prevalence.
Mitral valve degeneration was common in long-lived companion lineages.
Otitis externa prevalence was moderate in medium-lifespan cohorts.
Short-lifespan giant breeds carried increased GDV burden.
Long-lived cohorts showed cumulative CKD prevalence in later years.
